vacancy.title: Mechanical Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Excellent technical alignment with MSc high-tech mechanical design, precision engineering, FEM/thermal analysis and space instruments; valuable spaceflight-hardware experience at SRON Leiden. However the role targets new graduates to at most seven years of experience and NWO scale 8 caps base pay at EUR 4,634 gross/month, below the candidate's compensation target. Marked potentially under-level; not an ESTEC placement.
